csv_project_name: A/E for Continuing Professional Consulting Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fort Meade, Florida, pursuant to the "Consultants' Competitive Negotiations Act" (CCNA), Section 287.055, Florida Statutes, which governs the acquisition of professional architectural, engineering, landscape architectural, and surveying and mapping services, and as may be amended, hereby requests Qualification and Performance Data from Professional Consultants practicing in the following specific types of professional work categories: A. Civil Engineering 1. In General 2. Acting as City Engineer, including review of development projects within City boundary, as needed B. Transportation Engineering 1. In General 2. Review of development projects within City boundary and development projects within adjacent boundaries, as needed. C. Architectural Design D. Landscape Architect (Includes Land Planning) E. Construction Engineering and Inspection (CEI) Services F. Geo-Technical, Construction Materials Testing and Inspection Services G. Surveying and Mapping Services H. Mechanical/Electrical/Plumbing Services I. Utilities Engineering J. Structural Engineering K. General Consulting Engineering
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Structural Engineering

title: A/E for Continuing Professional Consulting Services
short_description: Framework solicitation for multidisciplinary consulting services for the City of Fort Meade.
project_location: Fort Meade, Polk County, Florida, USA
project_scope: Renewable continuing professional consulting services contract for the City of Fort Meade covering multiple disciplines and on-call support. Requested categories include civil engineering, acting as City Engineer including review of development projects within city boundaries, transportation engineering including review of development projects within and adjacent to city boundaries, architectural design, landscape architecture including land planning, construction engineering and inspection, geotechnical and materials testing, surveying and mapping, MEP services, utilities engineering, structural engineering, and general consulting engineering. No specific building, bridge, span, floor area, or construction volume is defined.
services: Qualification-based professional consulting services under CCNA; multidisciplinary A/E services including civil, transportation, architecture, landscape architecture, CEI, geotechnical, materials testing, surveying/mapping, MEP, utilities, structural engineering, and general consulting engineering; on-call/continuing services; base period 12 months with renewals up to 48 months.
relevance_explanation:
- General continuing services/framework-style solicitation without a defined project or structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but only as one of many disciplines.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, tower, or complex building is identified.
- Scope strongly includes many low-priority areas for sbp such as MEP, surveying, geotechnical, inspection, and general municipal support.
- Potential strategic value is limited because technical specification and structural ambition are unclear.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. This is a continuing professional consulting services solicitation with no defined individual project, building size, span, or construction quantity, so a realistic project construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The procurement is for renewable on-call consulting services under CCNA with multiple disciplines and no defined task volume, so a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualification and performance data from professional consultants are requested under Florida CCNA for specified disciplines. The notice indicates continuing professional consulting services and implies experience in the listed categories, including civil, transportation, architecture, landscape architecture, CEI, geotechnical/materials testing, surveying/mapping, MEP, utilities, structural engineering, and general consulting engineering. No specific minimum number of references is stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Selection under the Consultants' Competitive Negotiations Act (CCNA). Specific weighted award criteria are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Fort Meade, Fort Meade, Florida, USA. Contact: Troy Bell. Phone: 863-285-1100. Fax: 863-285-1125. Email: tbell@cityoffortmeade.org. Website: https://www.demandstar.com/app/suppliers/bids/540310/details
notes: Project #868686-2; solicitation/project number 2026-05. Questions deadline: 2026-07-06 04:00 PM EDT. Contract duration marked renewable; base period 12 months with 48 months renewal option. The notice is broad municipal on-call consulting rather than a specific building or structure tender. Includes rehabilitation & refurbishment among requested disciplines.
